# Agents instructions for this directory

**This is a sealed application tree. Do not edit any file in it.**

Read `SEALED.md` in this directory before doing anything else. The
short version: this checkout is replaced wholesale by every update,
so an edit made here is destroyed silently and reaches nobody. Read
anything you like; write nothing.

Write to the `home` directory beside this one instead: its
`tars-workshop` folder for scratch work and drafts, its
`downloads` folder for files you fetch.

If the task genuinely requires changing this application, that work
belongs in its development repository, not in the installed copy.
Say so and stop rather than approximating the fix here.
